order_policy: development_order is User-directed probe order only; it is not a score, quality ranking, hardware disposition, or qualification decision.
memory_policy: Record peak process-tree RSS and whether it exceeds the reference. Never terminate or eliminate a POC candidate solely because of this observation.

disposition_meaning.LOCKABLE: Metadata supports preparing a separate clean-SHA probe packet; this does not authorize acquisition or imply target feasibility.
disposition_meaning.STOP: Preserve the row and perform no acquisition or execution in the current M1 method.

sources_policy: Technical claims use project-owner, official repository, release, package-index, or model-repository metadata only.
